Chromium in this sandbox is the system build 156 driven via executable_path because the bundled playwright chromium build is absent from the image; CI installs both playwright browsers, so CI coverage is the canonical one.

Firefox clipboard reads rely on Firefox's own testing preference (dom.events.testing.asyncClipboard). The production code path is untouched and still uses navigator.clipboard with a DOM execCommand fallback; the preference only lets the test read the real clipboard.

JS bounds mirror Python (1 TiB KV, 33 554 432 positions, batch 4096), but the browser sanitises (clamp + notice) where the CLI refuses; this asymmetry is intentional for a UI and is covered by tests on both sides.

Explicit manual overhead 0 is preserved as an explicit zero bound in the UI/URL/report, but core compute_ledger still treats manual_overhead_gib=0 as provided=manual_bound (covered), so there is no 'unknown' ambiguity left in the JSON.
